description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain reference casting and interface compatibility, focusing on verifying correct cast behavior, interface hierarchies, and exception handling in grain reference operations.

classes.name: GrainReferenceCastTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests validating grain reference casting and interface operations in Orleans.

methods.name: CastGrainRefCastFromMyType
methods.description: Tests casting a grain reference to the same interface type.

methods.name: CastGrainRefCastFromMyTypePolymorphic
methods.description: Tests casting between multiple interfaces implemented by the same grain.

methods.name: CastMultifacetRWReference
methods.description: Verifies casting between reader and writer interfaces on a multifaceted grain.

methods.name: CastMultifacetRWReferenceWaitForResolve
methods.description: Verifies casting with resolution waiting between interfaces.

methods.name: CastFailInternalCastFromBadType
methods.description: Ensures that invalid casting attempts throw exceptions.

methods.name: CastInternalCastFromMyType
methods.description: Checks that casting a grain to its own interface is a no-op.

methods.name: CastInternalCastUpFromChild
methods.description: Tests upcasting from a derived to a base interface.

methods.name: CastGrainRefUpCastFromChild
methods.description: Verifies grain reference upcasting from a child interface.

methods.name: FailSideCastAfterResolve
methods.description: Ensures invalid side-cast attempts fail after resolution.

methods.name: FailOperationAfterSideCast
methods.description: Tests that operations on invalidly cast grains throw exceptions.

methods.name: FailSideCastAfterContinueWith
methods.description: Validates async continuation chain failures due to invalid cast.

methods.name: CastGrainRefUpCastFromGrandchild
methods.description: Checks upcasting from a grandchild interface to parent interfaces with cross-hierarchy assertions.

methods.name: CastGrainRefUpCastFromDerivedDerivedChild
methods.description: Verifies upcasting from deeply nested derived interfaces.

methods.name: CastAsyncGrainRefCastFromSelf
methods.description: Validates method calls on grain references cast to their own interface.

methods.name: CastCallMethodInheritedFromBaseClass
methods.description: Tests calling inherited base interface methods after casting.
